# Session 12: which synapses were missing in the partial states? (auto-generated, v1822)

V1->V1 synapses of the 193 fully extended axons. diff = mean similarity (degrees) of synapses not yet attached minus attached ones; negative = the missing synapses were onto MORE similar targets (their loss weakens the rule). Null: attachment permuted among each axon's synapses (within the stated bins), 2000 permutations; p two-sided, centred on the null mean.
